min.description: The smallest value; min equal to max (the zero value) is unbounded.

step.description: How much a press changes it; 0 is 1.

StepperResult.description: A stepper's response and value after this tick's input.

value.description: The value, to keep in game state and pass back next tick.

RadioDesc.description: How a radio group lays out.

horizontal.description: Options in a row (the default is a column).

CheckListResult.description: A checkbox list's response and values after this tick's input.

response.description: What happened to it; changed when any box flipped.

values.description: The values, to keep in game state and pass back next tick.

tone.description: Its tone: a dot of the tone's colour before the text.

durationMs.description: How long it stays; 0 is 3200 ms (6000 for danger).

MeterDesc.description: A meter: a capsule track with a fill that animates its changes by the tick.

kind.description: What it measures, which sets its colour.

color.description: A colour of your own instead of the kind's.

label.description: Text inside the bar (such as `75 / 100`); empty is none.

height.description: Its height; 0 is space.md, or the caption's line with a label.

segments.description: Notches dividing it into this many parts; 0 or 1 is none.

CooldownDesc.description: A cooldown ring's size and centre.

label.description: Text in the middle (a key, seconds left); empty is none.

icon.description: An icon of the atlas in the middle, by name; empty is none.

tone.description: Its colour; neutral is the stage ink.

player.description: The player: the accent, larger, ringed.

texture.description: The map; null is the stage colour.

uv.description: The region of the map shown, [u0, v0, u1, v1]; null is the whole texture.

label.description: A zone name under it; empty is none.

DialogueDesc.description: A dialogue box: a portrait slot, the speaker and the line typed out by the tick.

text.description: The line. A new text starts typing again.

portrait.description: A portrait texture; null is the speaker's initial.

portraitUv.description: The portrait's region of the texture; null is the whole texture.

portraitIcon.description: A portrait from the icon atlas by name, when no texture is given; empty is the speaker's initial.

DialogueResult.description: A dialogue box's answer this tick.

advanced.description: Pressed (or activated) while done: show the next line.

size.description: The base's diameter; 0 is 128 (never under three touch targets).

x.description: -1 left to 1 right; 0 inside the dead zone.

y.description: -1 up to 1 down; 0 inside the dead zone.

active.description: A press that started on it is held.

size.description: The pad's size; 0 is 132 (each arm at least 44).

DpadResult.description: Which arms of a d-pad are held this tick.

ActionButtonDesc.description: A round touch action button (jump, fire).

icon.description: An icon of the atlas by name, instead of the label; empty is the label.

SkeletonDesc.description: A skeleton: the neutral fill standing in for content that is loading.

height.description: A line's height; 0 is the body size.

lines.description: Stacked lines; 0 or 1 is one, the last of several is shorter.

MenuItem.description: An item of a menu: an id the game acts on and the label a player reads.

id.description: The id answered when it is chosen; also its probe id.

MenuResult.description: What a menu-like template answered this tick.

selected.description: The id of the item chosen this tick.

MainMenuDesc.description: A title screen: the title, a subtitle, a column of items (the first primary unless one says so) and a footer. Centred on desktop and tablet, bottom-weighted on a phone.

title.description: The game's title, in display type.

subtitle.description: A line under it; empty is none.

items.description: The items, such as Play, Continue, Settings, Quit.

footer.description: A line at the bottom (a version, credits); empty is none.

onSelect.description: Called with the chosen item's id.

PauseMenuDesc.description: A pause screen: a dialog over the frozen game with Resume first. Back resumes.

items.description: The items; empty is Resume, Settings, Quit to menu (`resume`, `settings`, `quit`).

onSelect.description: Called with the chosen item's id; Back answers `resume`.

KeyBinding.description: A control the settings screen lists: an action and the key bound to it.

LanguageOption.description: A language the settings screen offers, in its own name.

label.description: Its name in itself (`English`, `简体中文`).

GameSettings.description: The settings most games share. The game keeps them (a resource, a save) and passes them in every tick.

reducedMotion.description: Keep state changes, drop movement (the UI's transitions only fade).

vibration.description: Vibrate on hits (where the device can).

bindings.description: The controls, as shown on the Controls tab.

SettingsDesc.description: A settings screen: Audio, Graphics, Controls and Language tabs (a select on a phone) over the game's settings, with persistence hooks.

languages.description: The languages offered; empty hides the Language tab.

onChange.description: Called on every change (apply it at once: volume, contrast).

onSave.description: Called when the screen closes after changes (persist here).

SettingsResult.description: The settings screen's answer this tick.

settings.description: The settings after this tick's input: keep them.

closed.description: The player closed the screen (Back, Done): set open false.

Ability.description: An ability on a HUD: a cooldown ring with its key.

key.description: The key or button shown in the middle.

icon.description: An icon of the atlas instead of the key; empty is the key.

remaining.description: How much of its cooldown is left: 1 just used, 0 ready.

PlatformerHudDesc.description: A platformer HUD: lives as hearts and a level name top left, coins and score top right, a timer, a pause button.

level.description: The level's name; empty is none.

timeLeft.description: Seconds left; null hides the timer.

health.description: A health bar instead of hearts, 0 to 1; null shows hearts.

touch.description: Show touch controls (a d-pad and Jump) on phones and tablets.

HudResult.description: What a HUD answered this tick.

paused.description: The pause button was pressed (or Back).

action.description: A HUD action pressed this tick (an ability's id, `jump`, a generator's `buy:<id>`, `tap`).

moveX.description: The touch controls' horizontal input, -1 to 1.

moveY.description: The touch controls' vertical input, -1 (up) to 1.

held.description: The touch action buttons held this tick.

ShooterHudDesc.description: A shooter HUD: health and armor bottom left, ammo bottom right, abilities as cooldown rings, kills top right, a crosshair, an optional mini-map.

crosshair.description: Draw a crosshair at the centre.

map.description: A mini-map top left; null is none.

touch.description: Show touch controls (a stick and Fire) on phones and tablets.

PuzzleHudDesc.description: A puzzle HUD: level and moves, the score towards a target with three star marks, an optional timer.

stars.description: The scores for one, two and three stars; empty is a third, two thirds and all of the target.

Currency.description: A currency an idle game counts.

perSecond.description: How much it earns per second.

icon.description: An icon of the atlas; empty is none.

Generator.description: A generator an idle game lists: level, cost, progress.

affordable.description: The player can pay for it.

icon.description: An icon of the atlas; empty is none.

IdleHudDesc.description: An idle or incremental HUD: currencies with their rates on top, a big tap target, the generators in a list.

currencies.description: The currencies, the first the main one.

tapLabel.description: The tap target's label; empty hides it.

RacingHudDesc.description: A racing HUD: position and lap top left, the times top right, the speedometer and gear bottom right, the boost meter, an optional mini-map.

best.description: The best lap in seconds; null hides it.

touch.description: Show touch controls (steering arrows, Brake, Boost) on phones and tablets.

portrait.description: An icon of the atlas as the portrait; empty is the speaker's initial.

CutsceneDesc.description: A dialogue scene: letterbox bars, the dialogue box at the bottom, Skip at the top right.

index.description: The line shown, from game state.
The line to show next tick: keep it.

finished.description: The last line was advanced past.

price.description: Its price in the shop's currency.

icon.description: An icon of the atlas; empty is none.

category.description: Its category tab; empty is the first.

owned.description: Already owned (one-off items): shown, not for sale.

ShopDesc.description: A shop: the balance, category tabs, a grid of items with prices, a detail panel with Buy (disabled when the balance is short).

currencyIcon.description: The currency's icon; empty is none.

categories.description: Category tabs; empty is one list.

onBuy.description: Called with the bought item's id.

bought.description: The item bought this tick: take the price and grant it.

count.description: How many (stacks); 0 or 1 hides the count.

icon.description: An icon of the atlas; empty is its initial.

InventoryDesc.description: An inventory: a grid of slots, items dragged between them, a detail panel with Use.

useLabel.description: The detail panel's action; empty hides it.

SlotMove.description: An item dragged from one slot to another.

to.description: The slot it was dropped on (swap when that slot holds an item).

moved.description: A drag and drop this tick: move (or swap) the items.

used.description: The id of the item Use was pressed for.

LevelInfo.description: A level in a level select.

locked.description: Not yet reachable: a lock, inert.

best.description: The best result as shown; empty is none.

LevelSelectDesc.description: A level select: a grid of level cards with stars and locks, the total stars.

LevelSelectResult.description: A level select's answer this tick.

StatRow.description: A labelled value on a results screen.

ResultsDesc.description: A results screen: the title, stars that land one by one, the score counting up, the best (a badge for a new best), stats, actions and a share hook.

actions.description: The actions; empty is Retry, Next and Menu (`retry`, `next`, `menu`).

shareText.description: Text a share would post; empty hides Share.

onShare.description: Called with the share text when Share is pressed (the shell posts it).

LeaderboardDesc.description: A leaderboard: scope tabs, a virtualised list of ranks (medal colours for 1 to 3, the player highlighted), and honest loading, error and empty states.

scopes.description: Scope tabs (Today, This week, All time); empty is none.

error.description: Loading failed: this message and Retry.

empty.description: Shown when there are no rows.

scope.description: The scope tab chosen: keep it and load its rows.

TutorialStep.description: A step of a tutorial: the element to point at, a title and a line.

target.description: The element's id or path (as touch_move_to takes); empty points at nothing.

TutorialDesc.description: An onboarding overlay: a spotlight on each step's target, a callout beside it with Next and Skip, and the step count.

index.description: The step shown, from game state.
The step to show next tick: keep it.

finished.description: The last step's Done was pressed.

LoadingDesc.description: A loading screen: the title, a real progress bar (or a spinner while unknown) and tips that change by the tick.

progress.description: How far, 0 to 1; null is unknown (a spinner, never a fake bar).

ConfirmDesc.description: A confirm dialog: a title, a consequence sentence, Cancel and the action.

danger.description: The action destroys something: the danger button.

ConfirmResult.description: A confirm dialog's answer this tick.

AlertDesc.description: An alert: a title, a message and one button.

CoreAction.description: The actions the engine ships. Arguments follow the action, separated by `:`.

x-og-variants.touch_move_to: `touch_move_to:<ui id>`: move the pointer to a UI element.
x-og-variants.touch_move: `touch_move:x,y`: move the pointer to CSS pixel coordinates.
x-og-variants.touch_start: `touch_start`: press the pointer where it is.
x-og-variants.key_down: `key_down:<Key>`: hold a key by its code.
x-og-variants.type: `type:<text>`: type text, one key press per character.
x-og-variants.move_to_text: `move_to_text:[=]text[@N]`: move the pointer to the UI element showing the text (exactly with `=`, the Nth with `@N`).
x-og-variants.frame_entity: `frame_entity:<entity>`: point the camera at an entity.
x-og-variants.dump_world: `dump_world[:path]`: tables, systems and their matched counts.
x-og-variants.set: `set:<entity>.<component>.<field>=<value>`: a Tune write through the schema.
x-og-variants.pause: `pause`: hold the clock; advance still steps.
x-og-variants.help: `help`: list every action the channel knows, core and registered.

CommandDesc.description: How a registered action describes itself in `og run --help` and the wiki.

doc.description: One sentence on what it does.

CommandStep.description: One parsed step of a command script.

at.description: When it runs, in simulation seconds from the start of the script.

CommandInfo.description: One action as help lists it.

doc.description: One sentence on what it does.

core.description: Shipped with the engine (true) or registered by a module or a game.

untilTick.description: The tick of the last step.

warnings.description: Unknown actions and other skipped steps, each naming the fix.

PickResult.description: What a screen point resolved to.

entity.description: The probe id of the entity under the point.

world.description: Where the pick landed in world space: two components in the 2D profile, three in 3D; nothing pads a plane with an unmeasured zero.

source.description: Where a person would change it, as `player.ts::jump`.

ProbeTunable.description: One published tunable parameter and the range it means something over.

ProbeEntityRef.description: One entity the probe publishes in state().

ProbeTimings.description: The fixed timings head of state().

render.description: Time the last frame's render took; 0 without a renderer.

ProbeState.description: The probe's state(): a fixed head, then the game's own facts.

seed.description: The seed the world was assembled from.

ProbeOperation.description: One operation of a probe program, which runs in one evaluation so a scripted segment costs one round trip.

oneOf.description: Take fixed steps; answers the tick.
Read the state; answers `{ tick, state }`.
Pick a point; answers its result or null.
Read an entity's parameters; null is a refusal.

ProbeProgramResult.description: What a program observed: one answer per operation that ran. A false, or entity's null, stops the program and `refused` names its index.

refused.description: The index of the refusing operation, or null.

tick.description: The tick after the last operation that ran.

Hello.description: The wire's hello: who is speaking.

members.description: The probe members this build serves.

modules.description: The engine modules this build carries beyond the core (`physics`, `audio`, `ui`, `cook`), so a client knows which members do something.

BuildProfile.description: The build configuration; publish builds keep only the player-facing probe members.

x-og-variants.dev: A development build: every member, the command channel, dumps.
x-og-variants.release: An optimised build with every member.
x-og-variants.publish: A published game: hello, tick, state, pick, entity, input and capture only.

height.description: Height in pixels.

SweepDesc.description: A parameter sweep: for each value, restore the snapshot taken at the call, patch, advance and capture.

id.description: The probe id of the entity.

values.description: The values to try, in order.

steps.description: Fixed steps to advance after each patch.

width.description: Capture width; 0 is the render target's.

height.description: Capture height; 0 is the render target's.

SweepResult.description: A sweep's frames, one per value.

ReloadReport.description: What a hot reload did. Components are re-registered by name and migrated field by field through the schema.

tick.description: The tick the world was restored at.

ms.description: From bundle swap to restored world.

migrated.description: Fields carried across a layout change, as `Health.hp`.

dropped.description: Components or fields that no longer exist, dropped with their data.

warnings.description: Anything else worth reading, each naming the fix.

SnapshotInfo.description: A snapshot of the whole world (components, resources, Rng states, pending events) kept in the running process.

tick.description: The tick it was taken at.

hash.description: The world hash at that tick, hex: equal hashes mean equal worlds.

x-og-variants.world: Archetype tables, systems and their matched counts.

id.description: The probe id, for an entity dump.

SystemDump.description: One system. The engine fills reads, writes and matched for every system the game declared; ms is null because the probe reads no clock (state().timings has the tick's time).

matched.description: Entities its queries match now; null for a system the host did not declare to the probe.

reads.description: What it declared it reads; null when undeclared.

writes.description: What it declared it writes; null when undeclared.

ms.description: Time it took on the last tick; null when not measured.

components.description: Each component's field values, by component name.

UiElement.description: One UI element with its bounds.

id.description: Its stable id, as the command channel targets it.

parent.description: Its parent's id; empty at the root.

text.description: The text it shows, if any.

height.description: Height.

UiDump.description: The UI tree, flattened in draw order.

DumpResult.description: A dump, tagged by its kind.

components.description: Each component's field values, by component name.
